sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Swift is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "We've come a long way, haven't we? You've learned a great deal. Now you can teach the newcomers of Tarkov a thing or two yourself. Show them that without armor, they shouldn't even think about stepping outside their hiding place."

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text: - Eliminate any 10 targets without wearing any armor or helmets on Woods

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +3,000 EXP
- Jaeger Rep +0.1
- 80,000 Roubles
  - 84,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 92,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
"You made the old man proud. Carry the lessons forward."

sections.heading: Guide
sections.text:
This quest takes place on Woods. You are required to kill any 10 targets without wearing any armor vest, armored chest rig, armored headwear or armored face cover. Armored eyewear is allowed.

Bug: The ANA Tactical Alpha chest rig (MultiCam) is currently considered armored for this quest even when it's not.

If you want to protect yourself during this quest, you can choose to still wear armor, but unequip it before killing a PMC.
